title.value: A machine learning framework for neighbor generation in metaheuristic search
title.justification: The paper focuses on developing a machine learning framework for neighbor generation in metaheuristic search, as evidenced by its title.
title.quote: This paper presents a methodology for integrating machine learning techniques into metaheuristics for solving combinatorial optimization problems.

extractions.description: The paper presents a machine learning framework for neighbor generation in metaheuristic search, aiming to solve combinatorial optimization problems. It describes an efficient neighborhood structure using a transformation applied to selected subsets of variables. The methodology trains models to predict variable selections for promising solution neighbors based on structural information and problem characteristics. It is validated on two applications: Tabu Search for Wireless Network Optimization and Large Neighborhood Search for Mixed-Integer Programs.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the paper demonstrates applications in optimization for Wireless Network Optimization and MIPs, climate or ecological sustainable development is not a central theme.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We first define an efficient neighborhood structure constructed by applying a transformation to a selected subset of variables from the current solution.

primary_category.quote: We propose a general machine learning framework for neighbor generation in metaheuristic search.

secondary_categories.quote: We aim to learn a variable selection policy by which the subset transformation operator is able to produce neighborhoods containing high-quality solutions.
